notes.title: Patch 665
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29916920/9d2b38c56f0c9e6fd668b52ebff1d8216873e9dd.png[/img]

The new patch is already there.

1. New paths.
2. New lighting.
3. New foliage.
4. Balanced enemies.
5. Over hundred of bugs eliminated.

It's the biggest update before the full release (and console port). It does not change the fact that we are still counting on your feedback ready to improve the game wherever it's (im)possible.

BTW Reviews help a lot. You played a game and liked it? Please leave at least just a few words.

notes.title: Big Patch #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29916920/9d2b38c56f0c9e6fd668b52ebff1d8216873e9dd.png[/img]

We are changing the rules of Ultimate Summer. The list of fixes would be impossibly long. Let me give you only our TOP 10:

10. You can repair the traps with any gun.
9. The fountains give new boosts.
8. Upgrading traps is now much more comfortable (only one click needed).
7. In-game achievements are fixed.
6. We rebalanced the gameplay completely, and added new types of enemies and their behaviour.
5. HUD should be easy to understand now. You get notifications.
4. We added new comics.
3. Marvin gets skill points.
2. There are difficulty levels.
1. We rearranged the mechanics of extermination. You've got to control the color of your guns and traps, and match it with incoming enemies. More tactics, less random shit.

[b]We strongly recommend resetting the progress of the game.[/b]

Check it out. We're waiting for your feedback.

BTW We know we should tweak the weapons a little bit. It'll come with the next patch. See you there.
